object: French physicist (1892–1987). Nobel Prize 1929. Proposed wave-particle duality of matter — the idea that particles have wavelengths. Presented pilot-wave theory at Solvay as a deterministic alternative to Copenhagen and watched Pauli demolish it. The 7th Duc de Broglie.
